claims.object_text: destabilizes the global protein conformation and reduces transporter protein expression at total and cell surface
claims.quote: The GAT-1(Val125Met) mutation destabilizes the global protein conformation and reduces transporter protein expression at total and cell surface.

claims.object_text: localized intracellularly inside the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) in both HEK293T cells and astrocytes
claims.quote: The mutant transporter protein was localized intracellularly inside the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) in both HEK293T cells and astrocytes which may directly contribute to seizures in patients.

claims.object_text: high-throughput 3H radio-labeled GABA uptake assays in mouse astrocytes and neurons
claims.quote: high-throughput 3H radio-labeled GABA uptake assays in mouse astrocytes and neurons
Radioactive 3H-labeled GABA uptake assay indicated the mutation reduced the function of the mutant GAT-1(Val125Met) to ~30% of the wildtype.
The seizure phenotypes, ADHD, and impaired cognition are likely caused by a partial loss-of-function of GAT-1 due to protein destabilization resulting from the mutation.

claims.object_text: Reduced GAT-1 function in astrocytes and neurons may consequently alter brain network activities such as increased seizures and reduced attention
